IDENTIFIERS *National Science Foundation 


ABSTRACT 

Provided is a listing of all National Science 
Foundation (NSF) program grants and contracts awarded in Fiscal Year 
1982. The listing is organized by specific NSF programs within these 
areas: (1) mathematical and physical sciences; (2) engineering; (3) 
biological, behavioral, and social sciences; (4) astronomical, earth, 
and ocean sciences (includes Astronomy Research Centers and National 
Center for Atmospheric Research); (5) scientific, technological, and 
international affairs; (6) Ocean Drilling Program and United States 
Antarctic Research Program; (7) scientific and engineering personnel 
and education, and fellowships; (8) special foreign currency 
(includes scientific and technological information, scientific 
research, and international travel); and (9) graduate and minority 
graduate fellowships. Awards are arranged by state or country and, 
within each state or country, by institution. Information provided 
for each award includes principal investigator(s), project title, 
award number, project duration, and amount awarded. (JN)

INTRODUCTION 


This report is a listing of all NSF program grants and contracts awarded in 
Fiscal Year 1982 and is organized by NSF program. The awards are arranged 
by state or country and, within each state or country, by institution. A glossary 
at the end of the book lists institutions by cities. 


An asterisk following the award number indicates that the project is funded by 
more than one NSF program or appropriation and may appear more than 
once in the report. 


INCLUSION AND EXCLUSIONS 


This report includes all grants and contracts funded from the National Science 
Foundation’s Salaries and Expenses Appropriation and Special Foreign Cur- 
rency Appropriation. The report generally excludes the following: 


Transactions funded from Program Development aud Management Funds 
(such as procurements for routine housekeeping activities). 


Awards (or portions of awards) using funds transferzed to NSF by other 


federal agencies. 

Administrative transactions such as extensions of project duration or 
amendments to modify grant or contract terms which do not involve the 
obligation of FY 1982 funds.
